Torgima Individual System · Foundation Intelligence Layer
This prompt establishes the complete project scaffold, all database tables, the Bhudhi AGI nervous system infrastructure, and the first execution loop. Every future prompt builds on this foundation.

You are building Torgima — a deterministic AI-powered execution operating system. Users enter a Goal, Purpose, and Timeframe. The system validates the goal, creates a structured Blueprint (Plans → Targets → Phases → Projects → Actions → Orders), and then runs a continuous execution loop: Task → User Executes → Feedback → Signal → Condition → Control → New Task.

The AI layer is called Bhudhi — built on Anthropic Claude API. Bhudhi is not a chatbot. It is a controlled execution intelligence that operates inside strict system governance. Bhudhi interprets, structures, and advises. It never overrides signals, blueprints, or conditions.
THE THREE LAWS — NEVER VIOLATED IN ANY FILE
Signal values are calculated mathematically by the Signal Engine from real execution data. No Bhudhi call, agent, or API route writes to signal value fields. Ever.
Blueprint structure is enforced by the Control Engine. Bhudhi may propose restructures — these go to a governance queue and require approval. No direct blueprint mutation from Bhudhi.
Conditions are assigned by the Condition Engine from signal calculations. Bhudhi reads conditions and adapts output within them. It cannot assign or change conditions.
